description: Down-sampled telemetry snapshot from a tsukuru fab equipment unit. The high-rate raw stream goes over libp2p (per ADR-2605242545 §Decision 2 dual-channel); this record is the audit-trail down-sample written to MST. Per ADR-2605242545 §Decision 1.

equipmentDid.description: DID of the equipment unit, e.g., did:web:tsukuru.etzhayyim.com:equipment:litho:asml-na33-clone-001 (vendor-neutral).

processStep.description: Maps 1:1 to the silicon_* Pregel cell that supervises this equipment.

sampleIntervalMs.description: Down-sampling interval. High-rate raw is on libp2p; this MST record is the audit-trail down-sample.

metrics.description: JSON-encoded metric map. Per-step canonical keys are documented in 50-infra/silicon/equipment/<step>/docs/telemetry-keys.md (Phase 2 wave).
